items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: Venus is all women and quite a few others. But it's a lot of expensive long times.

ctx.x: You never do go along beside the Brex. They don't have women in the corner club or any of those clubs? No, they don't have them. Only men. Only men, yeah. Let's see, what's in the neighborhood here? The buzzards?

The garden? They have some clubs, women, but it would be too expensive for me to join. There's a lot of these night parades of women. Venus is all women and quite a few others. But it's a lot of expensive long times.
Is there any other club down here besides the right now, the Jefferson City Buzzards around here?
